problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of convex components and their average, with an attained global minimum.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: Objective f(x) = (1/n) Σ_i f_i(x), with n ≥ 1.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query (i,x) returns the exact component gradient together with its Hessian. Replies do not depend on history or oracle randomness.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact component Hessian oracle, bundled with the gradient in one counted call. Function values and third derivatives are not returned.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Each component is C³ with globally L-Lipschitz third derivative in operator norm. Public parameters satisfy L,G,H ≥ 0 and R,ε > 0. A hidden minimizer xstar satisfies ‖x0−xstar‖ ≤ R; the average objective satisfies ‖∇f(x0)‖ ≤ G and ‖∇²f(x0)‖ ≤ H. No global gradient or Hessian Lipschitz bound is imposed. All Params are public; components and xstar are hidden.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued output x with f(x)−f(xstar) ≤ ε on the success event.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: Success probability at least 2/3 under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law, within the supplied fixed oracle budget.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: An established higher-order smooth convex finite-sum formulation with exact component second-order information, a radius bound, and constant-probability objective accuracy. The initial derivative bounds explicitly parameterize the available information.

descriptionHtml:
Finite-Sum Convex Third-Order Smoothness

We consider minimizing f(x)=n−1∑i=1nfi(x) on a finite-dimensional real inner-product space E, where n≥1 is an integer. Each component fi:E→R is convex and three times continuously differentiable, with L-Lipschitz third derivative, where L≥0. A given point x0∈E lies within distance R>0 of a minimizer x⋆; its objective gradient and Hessian have norms bounded by G,H≥0, respectively. A query (i,x) returns (∇fi(x),∇2fi(x)). For ε>0, the goal is a measurable output x¯∈E satisfying P{f(x¯)−f(x⋆)≤ε}≥2/3, where P is the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E. Derivative norms ∥⋅∥op are the induced operator norms: the Hessian acts from E to E, and the third derivative is a trilinear form on E. The algorithm receives E,n,L,R,ε,G,H, and x0.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Component convexity and regularity). For every i∈{1,…,n}, the function fi belongs to C3(E;R), and for all x,y∈E and t∈[0,1], fi((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)fi(x)+tfi(y). Its third derivative satisfies ∥∇3fi(x)−∇3fi(y)∥op≤L∥x−y∥,x,y∈E.

Assumption 2 (Minimizer and initial bounds). The instance specifies a point x⋆∈E such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈E,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,∥∇f(x0)∥≤G,∥∇2f(x0)∥op≤H.

The oracle accepts any component index i∈{1,…,n} and any point x∈E, returning the exact component gradient and Hessian together in one call. After the allotted calls, the output x¯ must be measurable with respect to the Borel sets of E and satisfy P{f(x¯)−f(x⋆)≤ε}≥23.

import LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Defs
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Calculus
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.BorelSpace.Basic

namespace LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumThirdSmoothConvex

open OracleTemplate MeasureTheory
open FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex (objective)

structure Params where
  E : Type u
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [innerE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  n : ℕ
  [nonzero : NeZero n]
  L : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  G : ℝ
  H : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.innerE Params.finiteE Params.measurableE
  Params.borelE Params.nonzero

structure Problem (p : Params) where
  component : Fin p.n → p.E → ℝ
  xstar : p.E

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance := Problem
  Query p := Fin p.n × p.E
  Reply p := p.E × (p.E →L[ℝ] p.E)
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 0 ≤ p.L ∧ 0 < p.R ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧ 0 ≤ p.G ∧ 0 ≤ p.H
  admissible p F oracle :=
    (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 3 (F.component i)) ∧
    (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (F.component i)) ∧
    (∀ i x y, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (gradient (F.component i))) x -
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (gradient (F.component i))) y‖ ≤ p.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    IsMinOn (objective F.component) Set.univ F.xstar ∧
    ‖p.x0 - F.xstar‖ ≤ p.R ∧
    ‖gradient (objective F.component) p.x0‖ ≤ p.G ∧
    ‖fderiv ℝ (gradient (objective F.component)) p.x0‖ ≤ p.H ∧
    (∀ history seed i x, oracle.answer history (0, (i, x)) seed =
      (gradient (F.component i) x, fderiv ℝ (gradient (F.component i)) x))
  successful p F output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
    (2 / 3 : ENNReal) ≤ (P : Measure _) {ω |
      objective F.component (output ω) - objective F.component F.xstar ≤ p.ε}

end LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumThirdSmoothConvex
